# ChatPush MCP Server

> Official open-source (MIT) MCP server for ChatPush, a Russian business messaging service. It lets Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other AI agents send WhatsApp, Telegram (personal account or bot), MAX, SMS and VK/OK messages, files and bulk mailings, check delivery status and connect a messenger by QR code. npm package: chatpush-mcp-server. MCP Registry name: io.github.ChatPush/whatsapp-telegram-max-sms.

Requires a ChatPush API token (sign up at https://chatpush.ru/customers/sign_up?partner=apimcp, 10 days free; token in Dashboard → Integrations). Runs locally via `npx -y chatpush-mcp-server` with env CHATPUSH_TOKEN, or as a Claude Desktop extension (.mcpb). The hosted endpoint https://mcp.chatpush.ru/mcp is launching soon.

## Docs

- [README (Russian)](https://github.com/ChatPush/mcp-chatpush/blob/main/README.md): setup for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code; tools; channels and cascade
- [README (English)](https://github.com/ChatPush/mcp-chatpush/blob/main/README.en.md): same in English, plus remote mode, deployment and behaviour details
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ChatPush/mcp-chatpush/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an agent should install the server and call its tools safely
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/ChatPush/mcp-chatpush/blob/main/skills/chatpush/SKILL.md): when and how an agent should use ChatPush, safe-sending rules
- [Guides](https://github.com/ChatPush/mcp-chatpush/tree/main/guides): Claude + Telegram, Claude + WhatsApp, Claude + MAX, Cursor and VS Code (Russian)

- [ChatPush API](https://chatpush.ru/services/apismpp)
